user.title: Set up TITSA (Tenerife)
user.description: Independent, unofficial Home Assistant community integration, not affiliated with, endorsed, or supported by Transportes Interurbanos de Tenerife, S.A. (TITSA) or Cabildo Insular de Tenerife. Uses official Open Data (CC BY 4.0) and real-time stop arrival estimates. Once added, use 'Add stop' inside the integration to monitor one or more bus stops.

abort.already_configured: This bus stop is already configured.
abort.entry_not_loaded: The TITSA integration must be loaded before adding or reconfiguring stops.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to TITSA. Please try again in a moment.
error.invalid_line: One or more entered lines are not valid for this stop. Pick valid lines from the dropdown.
error.stop_not_found: No matching bus stop was found. Check the stop code or try a different name.

user.title: Find a TITSA bus stop
user.description: Enter the numeric stop code (e.g. 1580) or part of the stop name (e.g. Nuevo Obrero) and click Next to search.

data_description.stop_query: Stop code from the bus shelter or part of the stop name.

select_stop.title: Select bus stop
select_stop.description: Multiple stops matched your search. Choose the exact stop (check the stop code and routes for the right direction) or enable 'Search for a different stop' to try again.

data_description.search_again: Enable this option and continue to return to the stop search without selecting a stop.

configure.title: Configure stop {stop_id}
configure.description: Selected stop: {stop_name} ({stop_id}). Choose optional line filters and schedule window below, or enable 'Search for a different stop' to go back.

data.name: Custom display name in Home Assistant (alias)
data.search_again: Search for a different stop (go back)

data_description.lines: Select specific valid lines for this stop. An individual sensor is created for each selected line; leave empty to track all lines with a single aggregated sensor.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional Schedule, Binary Sensor, or Input Boolean helper. When off, polling pauses completely (0 HTTP requests) and entities stay unknown instead of unavailable.
data_description.name: Only changes the device display name in Home Assistant; it does not change the selected bus stop.
data_description.search_again: Enable this option and submit to return to the stop search without saving.

refresh_cooldown.message: Please wait {seconds} seconds before refreshing this stop again.
